
### Maintenance / Chore PR

**Purpose of This PR**  
_Describe the non-feature, non-bugfix task — e.g., dependency bump, file cleanup, tooling._

**What's Included**
- [ ] Dependency updates
- [ ] Code formatting / linting
- [ ] File or directory structure updates
- [ ] Docs cleanup or contribution guidelines

**Impact**
> _Should not affect production logic or introduce new features._

---

### Checklist
- [ ] Changes are low-risk and non-breaking
- [ ] No user-facing logic affected
- [ ] Tested (if applicable)
